card.name: Linking words before risk of transmission
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of" or "the" right after "transmission" or "increases", just before the word "risk" or an infection term. Mostly in warnings about blood-derived products and opioid-benzodiazepine use.

modes.label: Transmission of infection
modes.description: The word "of" after "transmission", or a verb like "carry" or "transmitting", in statements about infectious agents from human blood or plasma products.
modes.example: it carries an extremely remote risk for transmission<< of>> viral diseases.

modes.label: Increases the risk
modes.description: The word "the" after "increases" before "risk" in opioid and benzodiazepine warnings.
modes.example: concomitant use of opioid analgesics and benzodiazepines increases<< the>> risk of drug-related mortality

card.plain: It fires on the small word that comes just before a risk or infection-transmission phrase in warning text.
